args.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM memory.bench.orders) AS orders_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM memory.bench.legacy_orders) AS legacy_cnt

transcript.text:
Based on the schema comparison: `memory.bench.orders` (1200 rows, richer schema with `order_ts`, `status`, `discount`) appears to be the current, actively maintained orders table. `memory.bench.legacy_orders` has only 60 rows, an older/simpler schema (just `order_id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`, `total`), and its order_id range overlaps the start of the current `orders` table (starting at 1000) — consistent with it being a small, stale partial extract from a prior/retired ingestion pipeline that was never fully migrated or cleaned up.

FINAL ANSWER: memory.bench.legacy_orders
